title: Plus Size See-through Sequin Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a stunning entrance at any wedding in our Plus Size See-through Sequin Wedding Guest Dress! This enchanting gown features a delicate sheer overlay adorned with sparkling sequins, creating a mesmerizing effect. The flattering silhouette and elegant design ensure you'll shine while celebrating love in style!


Tips: This A-line style offers a relaxed fit at the hips. Choose your size based on bust and waist. Fabric has no stretch and go with the larger size if you fall between sizes.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap Sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
